verdict.rationale: Rootly documents inline action item tracking in its retrospective editor and says retrospective processes "drive follow-ups" through configurable steps. Its workflow engine includes a Jira action category and files tickets automatically. However, nothing in the evidence shows action items themselves syncing to Jira or another tracker, or completion status flowing back. Missing for 10: explicit action-item-to-issue-tracker sync (bidirectional status), documentation of tracking items to completion (owners, due dates, overdue reminders), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
